title: AntiFan FixRequest v2
description: Schema for machine-readable fix requests issued to the builder-fixer worker in AntiFan B-Lite v2. Pinned staged workspace, no HTML/CSS snapshot.

runId.description: Unique identifier for the repair run

fixId.description: Unique identifier for this fix attempt within the run

surfaceId.description: Identifier of the theme surface under repair

stagedRoot.description: Filesystem path to the isolated staged workspace directory. Effective workspace root is pinned here; paths containing .antifan-data are strictly rejected.

baseManifestHash.description: Cryptographic hash (e.g. sha256-...) of the base manifest computed at staging time, used for drift detection before merge

allowedFiles.description: Exhaustive list of relative file paths within stagedRoot that the fixer is permitted to touch

forbiddenPaths.description: Glob patterns or relative paths that must NEVER be modified (e.g. .antifan-data/**, src/**, package.json)

diffBudget.description: Bounds total touched file count (|T|) and total changed bytes across all touched files

maxFiles.description: Maximum number of distinct files permitted to be touched (|T| <= maxFiles)

maxBytes.description: Maximum total bytes of net change permitted across touched files

maxScopeExpansion.description: Bounds the number of additional files touched outside requestedTargets (|T \ R| <= maxScopeExpansion). Refused independently from diffBudget.

requestedTargets.description: The primary target file(s) R identified as needing the fix. Subset of allowedFiles.

evidenceRefs.description: Paths to diagnostic evidence artifacts (e.g. diff heatmaps, DOM inspection reports) produced by the AntiFan engine

targetCauseCode.description: Specific failure cause code from the AntiFan verification engine targeted for repair (e.g. GEOMETRY_OVERFLOW_X, LAYOUT_SHIFT)

toolSurface.description: Optional specification of permitted tools and forbidden tool patterns
